verified: Meta rolled out its personal AI agent Muse to UK adults, as reported by Politico, which characterizes it as the first Big Tech AI agent launch in the UK.
unconfirmed: which everyday tasks Muse performs, its price and platform availability, the specific content of UK watchdogs' warnings about agents, and whether Meta has launched Muse in other markets; the "first Big Tech" description rests on Politico's reporting rather than an independent count.

verified: Politico 报道，Meta 已向英国成年人推出 Muse，并将其描述为首家在英国推出 AI 代理的大型科技公司。
unconfirmed: Muse 的具体能力、价格、完整覆盖范围及独立测试结果均未在报道中披露；英国监管机构是否已对 Muse 采取正式行动也尚无消息。

titles.en: Meta rolls out Muse agent to UK adults, a Big Tech first, Politico reports
titles.zh: Meta 在英国向成年人推出个人 AI 代理 Muse
